svg.title: EduFeed sentiment analysis — Bidirectional LSTM architecture with dataset
svg.desc: End-to-end pipeline from Google Forms input through NLP preprocessing, embedding, Bidirectional LSTM, dense layers, sentiment classification, Groq LLM explanation, to final output.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Google Forms send data to the deployed model?')
sendPrompt('What does text cleaning do in this model?')
sendPrompt('How does the Keras Tokenizer convert words to integers?')
sendPrompt('Why is sequence padding needed before the LSTM?')
sendPrompt('What does the Embedding layer do before the Bidirectional LSTM?')
sendPrompt('How does the Bidirectional LSTM work in a sentiment model?')
g.text: forward + backward pass · captures full context

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What do the Dense and Dropout layers do after the BiLSTM?')
sendPrompt('Tell me about the dataset used to train this model')
sendPrompt('What training callbacks were used in this model?')
sendPrompt('What does a Negative sentiment prediction mean?')
sendPrompt('What does a Neutral sentiment prediction mean?')
sendPrompt('What does a Positive sentiment prediction mean?')
sendPrompt('What does the Groq LLM do in the EduFeed pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does the final educator-facing response look like?')
